L=np.log(1+t)**2
ps=np.arange(-2,4.01,0.25)
y=dv_dt
res=[]
for p in ps:
  for q in ps:
    for form in ['xp+vq','xpvq+vq','xp+xpvq','xpvq+L_only']:
        xp=np.abs(x)**p; vq=np.abs(v)**q
        if form=='xp+vq': cols=[L,xp,vq]
        elif form=='xpvq+vq': cols=[L,xp*vq,vq]
        elif form=='xp+xpvq': cols=[L,xp,xp*vq]
        else: cols=[L,xp*vq,xp*vq*0+1]
        A=np.column_stack(cols)
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
        r=np.mean((A@c-y)**2)/np.var(y)
        res.append((r,p,q,form,c))
res.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
for z in res[:8]: print(z)
